No dispatch/approval/hold release/reader termination capability or storage port/MinIO root credential path exists.
source_assessment.history_and_cost: New observer only revokes the hardcoded original approvals when needed and records exact NOT_SENT via existing service. It never rewrites attempts, old approval, UNKNOWN, budget, pins or original provider facts. NOT_SENT yields no fictional provider CostEvent; known conflict fails. Per-case committed revocations/observations/releases survive any later failure; no all-three rollback or resend path is introduced.
source_assessment.idempotency_and_results: Command keys are new AuditID+fixed case+operation, existing service fingerprint/replay prevents duplicate facts. Result uses O_EXCL and preserves partial case results/original error. This is a one-shot source, not approval for resuming a failed host audit; host lifecycle/replay/containment still needs its own review.
source_assessment.required_success_path: Service constructors with nil disposal dependencies/approval grant port are usable for Revoke+Observe only; canonical routing is installed before either command. The worker initializes no sender, Native adapter, IAM helper or queue.
